notes.title: A New Perspective.
notes.content:
Here we are with a new update, and we’re getting closer and closer to the end of the first chapter.

We added fewer areas this time, though they started to become more and more intricate gameplay wise, and changed some animations to get the stiffness out of Thyra while introducing a few new ones. As usual we also improved the scripts and other internal workings of the game, and we hope you will enjoy them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838691/44572bfaa17b37064d3982ba4f467a250d6379be.png[/img]

We’re really happy with how Project Utgardr is going and we’re excited to share, when the time is right, news of our next and last major update for the Early Access, that will mark the end of the first chapter.

We hope to see you again for our biggest step yet.
The TronusGames team.


[h3]Wishlist the game on the store page or Pre-Purchase it... Find out more on the game website and socials![/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1878290/Project_Utgardr

Website. https://bio.link/projectutgardr

Discord. https://discord.com/invite/hdx8dVpmaU

notes.title: Project Updates #6 | EA v0.1.3 patch notes

tags.bug: - Camera vertical pitch rotation bug solved where it entered in gimbal lock, vertical speed decreased to fit horizontal speed;
- Crouch jump bug where when you are crouched you could jump and hear the jump voice, solved;
- Jump idle sound now works;
- Landing sound check implemented (it happens not on every jump) and footsteps are less inaccurate;
- Thyra now looks less sweaty;
- Animation and transition fixes and smoothing;
- First jump animation now appears only in idle;
- Crouch head back bone disabled;
- Head animation constraint increased so that the head bone views in front;
- Crouch animation blend to less fast;
- During walk and crouch hairs on camera fixed;
- Rebuilt collision meshes on some meshes/rocks to simplify character's jittering and collisions performance;
- Few UI, texts and typos fixes, synched with the new text style;

tags.balance_change: - Camera position and max look up degrees range increased (90, -48);
- Jump force 10% decreased and jump z velocity increased. Thyra jumps higher;
- Fall damage distance slightly increased, ground offset removed, fx and debuff increased;
- Climb up and hands IK less inaccurate and less hand deformations;
- Directional light intensity slightly decreased and post process exposure changed the type and intesity increased;

notes.title: Project Updates #1 | The Early Access is coming
notes.content:
Greetings explorers of Utgardr, how are you?

We are reaching this point actually.
This fall of January, be ready to find the Early Access of Project Utgardr here and also on the other stores where we landed -> [url=https://bio.link/projectutgardr]website[/url].

There will be some new features inside... for a discounted price...


We want to release it since it can help us to fund this game and all our work (this project started 12 months ago).
Also it is important to show something else to the players and to get their comments and ideas to improve the game with its features and environments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838691/3a679970f1ed9c4d5ebe1260c534e83c564abc20.gif[/img]


The whole project is proceeding well. Here below there are a couple of things that we will work for this Early Access and after the release of it:

[list]
[*]     New gameplay features inside (such as some old altars where you could find the old tale of Utgardr).
[*]     New 3d and 2d assets, to create new zones and ambients and also to improve the menu and the Ui.
[*]     We want to change the game name, to one that satisfies the Norse mythology, storyline and gameplay...
[*]     If you got any idea, write it in the comments below, so we can take it into consideration.
[*]     Other forgotten zones to explore, not present in the Demo.
[*]     Other hidden parts and mysteries to explore.
[*]     Original music for each scene (Home, in game...) and also for the different environments present inside (thanks to our composer Diego La Prova, here you can see and [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5qNktStp_yA]listen the first track[/url] he made).
[*]     We want to divide the project in 3 main chapters, each of them lasting around 2/3 hours.
[*]     The first chapter is under development and it will be released not completely for this Early Access, but it will be finished during it, focusing to develop the quality of the contents and not the quantity.
[*]     There will not be DLCs for this game. We want to release it at a discounted price during the Early Access and then increase the total price of it, when new chapters will be released. Every chapter (not counting the first one) will increase the total price of about a couple of euros at the most.
[*]     So people that support now Utgardr, will get the full game without paying the price of when it will be fully released. This is how the games should be done, at least for me.
[*]     We want to sell as extra contents, only: the original hd soundtracks, the artbook and just these kind of things not related to some addition of the experience of the game. That must be for anyone the same, as i wrote above.
[*]     If needed, there could be the possibility to support the game with another specific Kickstarter campaign, that will permit people to shape (just a bit) the game inside. This is an example of our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tronusgames/project-utgardr]last campaign[/url], all detailed and explained.
[/list]


Well, we are really excited for this Early Access and how it will be received by the players.
So, feel free to share anything related to this post and to the points above mentioned. Utgardr is coming.

In the meantime, regards from the Utgardr team...


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838691/3ba15893a48ec06cdd7688bc091bf1c1d788a536.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Current game state and next plans
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838691/1af59c6c5754adce6a26b56248a8a377ec4215a8.png[/img]

Hello everyone, i hope you are doing well.
Some time passed, so i decided to make this post to inform you regarding the current path of this project. The amount of work is pretty high, so i couldn't post anything during this one and half month.


Actually the game is going ahead pretty well, as you can see in our social pages.
🔵 [url=https://facebook.com/projectutgardr]Facebook[/url]  
🔵 [url=https://twitter.com/projectutgardr]Twitter[/url] 
🟣 [url=https://instagram.com/projectutgardr]Instagram[/url]  
⚫ [url=https://tiktok.com/@tronusgames]TikTok[/url] 
🟠 [url=https://reddit.com/r/ProjectUtgardr]Reddit[/url]  
🔴 [url=https://youtube.com/channel/UCFgxHSCQQ5OJJWaLgthvUMA?sub_confirmation=1]YouTube[/url]
🟣 [url=https://twitch.tv/tronusgamesofficial/about]Twitch[/url]  
🟣 [url=https://discord.com/invite/hdx8dVpmaU]Discord[/url]


Lots of improvements regarding the gameplay and the 3d and 2d graphic are going on and will finish at the end of this month. 
This is mostly thanks to the help of the guys that are participating to this project:

[list]
[*]Marco Borrelli - 3d artist | [url=https://www.artstation.com/user-694939]Artstation[/url]
[*]Jonathan Calsolaro - 2d artist | [url=https://www.instagram.com/jonathancalsolaro]Instagram[/url]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838691/b5b096950ffbb0f7c673c683aeb33f78d1c5dc1d.jpg[/img]

They are doing a fantastic work with the creation of the new character called Thyra and the new Ui assets and the in game Norse runes made by Jonathan.


This is a [i][b]sneak peak[/b][/i] of what they are creating:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838691/f4440e7dbc0e8ca21c6860f33fef376d46f97c0e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838691/e65cb6fa6ba08a29a7388e046a6c63c3f72c2e76.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41838691/2f68779f413548f3adfc9f7ec7ed0669f40dd5ed.jpg[/img]



So now, since the game is going on in a good way and lots of new improvements have been done, the decision is to open in October [b]the first Early Access of the game[/b].
A new post will be made to inform you all about the precise date and procedures for the Early Access and also for the [b]Kickstarter campaign[/b].


[b]Kickstarter[/b] would be a [b]massive[/b] way to support the project, pay the game less and get lots of other benefits for the players and for who is developing the game. This is why probably it could start before the Early Access. 
There are some things to set up regarding these two procedures, so one good start point would be to [b]know your opinion regarding this[/b].


Would you prefer supporting Utgardr through [b]Kickstarter for a less price[/b], more benefits and wait one additional month for the Early Access [b]or pay the Early Access[/b] this October, paying the game a little more than buying it in the Kickstarter campaign?




Thanks for your opinions and for everyone that [b]wishlisted the game[/b]... we are more than 500!
